The amber garden trial found stable recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.
The ivory harbor trial found stable recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

# Protocol: Invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do the invented learning-garden records report about recall after guided sessions?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the public synthetic fixture (`fixture-001.json`) for the invented learning-gardens domain
- Report a recall outcome after guided sessions
- Full source text available in the fixture

## Exclusion criteria
- Any record not present in the supplied fixture
- No recall outcome reported

## Query log
- 2026-10-07: supplied fixture `fixture-001.json` (invented-index), 2 hits. No live backend searches run because the domain is entirely invented.

## Screening
- 2 records screened; 2 included (amber, ivory); 0 excluded.

## Retrieval summary
- 2 full-text / 0 abstract-only. No missing PDFs; drop-in path would be `papers/<id>/paper.pdf`.

## Notes
- Evaluation capture mode: criteria-approval checkpoint skipped; synthesis and claims copied verbatim from the fixture. Validation and delivery left to the evaluation harness.
The amber garden trial found stable recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial found stable recall (Vale, 2024).
